answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The marble cap is checked at intake and sable shows the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a vine tag. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
